target_fidelity.note: It is past perfect progressive, active, negative, declarative, with no modal.

grammaticality.note: The target sentence is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: The timing makes the negative statement coherent: she had waited only five minutes by 9:00.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It provides focused practice of the negative past perfect progressive with a clear time reference.

determinacy.note: The prompt does not sufficiently restrict valid surface forms; for example, “hadn't been waiting” is also a natural completion but is not accepted.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and bus-waiting context are common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The completed target verb phrase is not shown in the prompt.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: Solving it mainly requires the target tense/aspect/polarity and simple duration reasoning.

no_world_knowledge.note: All needed information is supplied in the prompt.
